narration: Most parents set up a 529 and feel great about it. But there's a fee hiding inside that could cost your kid twenty-three thousand dollars. Let me show you the math.
visual: Parent and child silhouettes walking together, graduation cap floating above, piggy bank labeled '529' spring-in, stat badge reading '54 Million Families Have a 529'

narration: Every 529 charges a fee called an expense ratio. The best plans charge just 0.05%. Some states charge 0.93% — that's nineteen times higher for the exact same investment.
visual: Animated bar chart: a tiny green bar for 0.05% (best plans, Utah/Nevada) vs a massive red bar for 0.93% (worst state plans), '19x HIGHER' badge drops in

narration: On a hundred thousand dollars over eighteen years, that fee gap doesn't sound like much. But compound it out and you've quietly handed twenty-three thousand dollars straight to your plan provider.
visual: Two animated columns growing — green tall column for low-fee plan ending at $323K, red shorter column for high-fee plan at $300K, animated gap counter ticking up to $23,000

narration: Here's the thing most people don't know — you're not locked into your home state's plan. You can open any state's 529 from anywhere in the country. Any state. Any family.
visual: Person silhouette in 'Your State' box, arrows pointing out to three floating cards: Utah (green, 0.05%), Nevada (green, 0.07%), generic 'Your State' (grey, 0.3-0.9%+)

narration: Utah's my529 plan charges just 0.05% and beats almost every plan in America. If your current state plan charges more than 0.3%, you're overpaying — and it's time to switch.
visual: Comparison table rows animating in: Utah 0.05% (best), Nevada 0.07%, New York 0.09%, then a warning row for '16 States 0.3%+' in red with alert border

narration: Google your state's 529 expense ratio right now. If it's above 0.3%, switch to Utah or Nevada — it's free to open and takes fifteen minutes. That one move puts $23,000 back.
visual: Phone screen showing '529 fee' search results with Utah 0.05% highlighted green and home state 0.72% in red, graduation cap and diploma, green badge '+ $23,000' springs in
